All tests pass.

`habit done <name> [yesterday|YYYY-MM-DD]` now works — `src/cli.js` pops a trailing "yesterday" or ISO date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) off the args and passes it as the date to `done()`; with no date word it still defaults to today. Added `test/cli.test.js` covering all three cases.

One thing to decide: invalid-looking dates that don't match `yesterday` or `YYYY-MM-DD` (e.g. `sept 1`, `tomorrow`) are currently just treated as part of the habit name rather than erroring — let me know if you'd want those rejected with an error instead.
